text: This report recommends that the name "Milk Bottle Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located North of Oakcrest Avenue, extending East from Morton Road. This naming proposal complies with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy which can be found at https://www.toronto.ca/city-government/planning-development/street-naming/
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Milk Bottle Lane" for an existing public lane located North of Oakcrest Avenue, extending East from Morton Road.
